hero.description: Sculptures of the South Pacific and Cape Horn, inspired by the epic of great ships, navigators and writers under the Southern Cross.

biografia.texto: Chilean sculptor and National Prize of Plastic Arts, recognized for a career that unites the Andean tradition with monumental public sculpture. Trained in Chile and England, he has placed more than 50 works in urban spaces around the world, forging in stone, steel and wood a profound poetic reflection on matter and territory.
